memory_verse.text: "But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit comes on you; and you will be my witnesses in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the ends of the earth." — Acts 1:8

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
Imagine owning the most expensive, imported luxury car in the world a masterpiece of engineering with a powerful engine and a polished exterior. Yet, if just one tyre is flat, that multimillion-dollar machine becomes a source of frustration rather than a means of progress. You can rev the engine and shift the gears, but a punctured tyre will drive you crazy and lead to a breakdown. The entire weight of the vehicle, no matter its cost, rests on the simple, invisible presence of compressed air within the rubber.
​Air is one of the cheapest and most common elements on earth; it is everywhere, filling the atmosphere around us. However, the vast ocean of air surrounding the car does nothing to move it. For the car to run, that air must be captured, pressurized, and placed inside the tyre. It is not the air around the car that carries the load, but the air within it. Without that internal pressure, the car is grounded, uselessly spinning its wheels against the pavement.
​In the same way, the power of God is vast, infinite, and fills the entire universe. Yet, many believers live "flat" lives because they are content to live in the atmosphere of God’s power without ever filling their own souls with it. It is not enough to know that God is powerful or to be in a place where His Spirit is moving; you must intentionally "fill up" through prayer, the Word, and surrender. When the Holy Spirit dwells within you, He provides the internal pressure needed to carry the heavy loads of life and keep you moving forward smoothly, regardless of the road conditions.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: ​"A religion that is only on the outside is like a car with air only on the outside of its tyres—it looks the part, but it goes nowhere."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Heavenly Father, I thank You that Your power is available to me every single day. Forgive me for trying to drive my life on "flat tyres"—relying on my own strength and becoming frustrated. I recognize that just being near Your Word is not enough; I need Your Spirit to fill me from the inside out. I open my heart today and ask You to fill my soul with Your divine power. Give me the internal strength to carry my responsibilities and the grace to move forward in Your will.
Amen

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: If you feel "driven crazy" by the friction of life today, check your internal pressure. Don't just stand in the atmosphere of the church or the presence of others; take a moment to sit quietly and let God fill your heart. The road is long, but with His Spirit inside you, the ride will be smooth.
